meta.name: agent-team
meta.description: 统一管理多智能体角色的团队协作框架，支持智能体动态组合、灵活协作和扩展新角色。智能体本质上是"角色定义"，可以根据任务需求灵活组建团队，实现从会议决策到系统构建的完整能力。智能体角色明确分工：有干活的、有指挥的、有挑毛病的，能实时看到沟通过程，共享数据库记忆，确保上下文一致。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组建多智能体团队协作完成任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要管理多个智能体角色并协调它们协作完成任务
copy.tagline_en: Orchestrate multi-agent teams to collaborate on tasks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage multiple AI agents and coordinate their collaboration

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以管理多个智能体角色，组建团队协作完成任务。智能体分工明确：有干活的、指挥的和挑毛病的。你能看到它们实时讨论、共享记忆，确保上下文一致。
howto.when: 当任务需要多个专业领域协作，或需要多角度分析、决策时触发。例如技术架构决策、系统构建、产品定价等场景。

say.text: 请用技术决策团队评估微服务架构的可行性。
say.note: 你会看到主持人引导讨论，各智能体发言、辩论、形成共识。

say.text: 请用OPC团队构建AI短视频领域的系统。
say.note: 智能体按战略分析、产品架构、自动化工程三步协作。

say.text: 请用产品团队制定某产品的定价策略。
say.note: 包含市场分析、成本核算、定价讨论全过程。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can manage multiple agent roles and form teams to collaborate on tasks. Agents have clear roles: executors, directors, and reviewers. You can see real-time discussions and shared memory for consistent context.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a task requires multi-domain collaboration or multi-perspective analysis/decision-making, e.g., technical architecture decisions, system building, product pricing.

say_en.text: Use the technical decision team to evaluate microservice architecture feasibility.
say_en.note: You'll see the host guide discussion, agents debate and reach consensus.

say_en.text: Use the OPC team to build a system for AI short video domain.
say_en.note: Agents collaborate in three steps: strategy, product architecture, automation.

say_en.text: Use the product team to set pricing strategy for a product.
say_en.note: Includes market analysis, cost calculation, and pricing discussion.
